name: Zero page
description: Fastest-addressed RAM; commonly used for pointers and loop counters

name: Default screen memory
description: 1000 bytes, one per character cell on the default text screen

name: BASIC program start
description: Default load address for a BASIC stub / SYS launcher

name: Free RAM
description: Common location for machine code programs when BASIC/KERNAL ROM is banked in

name: VIC-II registers
description: Video chip registers (when I/O is banked in)

name: Color RAM
description: Nibble per screen cell, foreground color
